verdicts.reasoning: Confirmed by direct code comparison: queryDiscos.ts:184 and carousel.ts:86 both filter AND precoBrl >= 30 in their sparkline subqueries. The related-deals sparkline in disco/[slug]/page.tsx:270-276 and the style page sparkline in estilo/[slug]/page.tsx:131-138 are missing this exact filter. Products with historical sub-threshold prices will have those prices contaminate their sparkline charts.

Artist page uses all-60-price average (up to 1 year, no floor filter) vs queryDiscos.ts which uses 30-day average with precoBrl >= 30. Same product shows different desconto on artist page vs main listing. Fix requires filtering Prisma precos by precoBrl >= 30 in TypeScript before computing stats, and limiting media window to 30 days. Marking MANUAL_REVIEW due to required design judgment on which window to use.
